annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously prohibits a sender from sending any of the three specified frames (STREAM, STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED, RESET_STREAM) when the stream is in either the Data Recvd or Reset Recvd terminal states. The reference to “these frames” clearly points to the three frames listed earlier, and the terminal states are explicitly named. No alternative materially different interpretation or missing constraint is evident.
